entities.name: Claudio Angelo Giuseppe Calabrese

entities.summary: Claude-Ange-Joseph Calabrese was the Italian Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Aosta from his appointment by Pope Benedict XV on May 7, 1920, until his death on May 7, 1932.
